in_marathi.name: Vasudeva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dwelling in Vasu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vasudeva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Vasu, meaning 'dwelling'. Vasudeva is also the name of Lord Krishna's father.

in_bengali.name: Vasudeva

in_bengali.long_meaning: Vasudeva একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Vasu, meaning 'dwelling'. Vasudeva is also the name of Lord Krishna's father.
